nodes.title: kon/name gate 2 (claude/r8-gate2-name; naming still off until main removes it from NAMING_OFF). say:vertex-name is a chance pick (three random taps give a vertex-first or vertex-last name 1 in 6 at worst): one name is chanceMis at chance weight with nothing in rows, trail, seam or facts (say facts drop vertex_ok / arms_ok); the second occurrence names it, as find's tap does, on a level whose figure AND letters differ (nameSurface parts). Pairs: say 1 in 36, find 1 in 25 (worst blind rule 1 in 31), mixed 1 in 30. New FamilyLogic.faintSolve read by gradeLevel: the first fade-1 level with O at the asked angle's vertex, and find levels with no mix-up arc (wide key, outside vertex angle), solve at CHANCE_WEIGHT with no discriminates. kon/name undo keeps commits (Wapas takes back her arc or name, not the check). Reverse if: a judge shows a single ordinary slip or a blind rule over 1 in 10 for a pair on served levels; or children's swaps of two letter taps are measured common enough that two swaps on two levels pass 1 in 10 (then say needs a third sighting via chanceRepeat).

kon/name gate 2 proof, computed in tests/r8-games-kon-name-gate2.test.mjs over n = 621 say + 1,280 find generated levels (fades 1-3, first and later fade-1 levels, 8 say / 40 find seeds). Method: every three-tap name (64, and the 24 with three different letters) through konLogic.apply; slips = one tap on any other letter (18 per level) and one neighbouring swap; find blind = 1 of 5 arcs, blind rules = fixed arc / size rank / a corner; find slip = taps 8-32 board units past the key's touch disc in 72 directions, through arcHit. Results: say 1 in 6 (distinct) / 1 in 16 (repeats) on every level, letter slip 0, swap 1 in 1; find 1 in 5 on 672 levels with a mix-up arc, 0 on 608 (all 320 wide keys among them); worst blind rule 0.180; slip share on the mix-up arc worst 0.181, mean 0.014.
